Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records and docs, filtering by document ChEMBL ID. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id.
